providers.imageAlt: A plumber repairing pipes under a kitchen sink

q1.a: Gwani connects people in Minna and across Niger State with local service providers and shops. You can find a provider, request a quote or order products, and pay through the app.

q2.a: When you pay by card, transfer or USSD, the money is held safely (escrow) and only released to the provider after the job is done or the order is received. If something goes wrong, you can report a problem.

q3.a: Many providers accept cash when the job is done. You can see whether a provider takes cash before you book.

q4.a: Providers can verify their identity and their trade with documents that Gwani's team reviews. Verified providers show a badge on their profile.

q5.q: Do I need a phone number to sign up?
q5.a: Customers sign up with an email and a password, and can add a phone number later. Providers sign up with their phone number and verify it with a code.

q6.q: How much does it cost to join as a provider?
q6.a: Providers choose a monthly plan: Starter, Standard or Premium. The prices are shown in the For providers section. New providers start with a free trial.

q7.q: Can I use Gwani in Hausa?
q7.a: Yes. You can use Gwani in English or Hausa, and switch at any time.

q8.a: Across the 25 LGAs of Niger State, starting with Minna.
